label: Bible Study
prompt: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never _____. Believest thou this?
verse: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?
note: Jesus to Martha, four days after Lazarus died — and she answered with a full confession of faith.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, and the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our _____ in his own blood,
verse: And from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, and the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood,
note: John's opening praise: Jesus loved us and washed us from our sins.

label: Sunday School
prompt: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also the Lord sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his _____ filled the temple.
verse: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also the Lord sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple.
note: In the year King Uzziah died, Isaiah saw the Lord enthroned, his robe's train filling the whole temple.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But now he is dead, wherefore should I fast? can I bring him back again? I shall go to him, but he shall not _____ to me.
verse: But now he is dead, wherefore should I fast? can I bring him back again? I shall go to him, but he shall not return to me.
note: David stopped fasting when his infant son died — he would go to the child, but the child wouldn't come back.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And whosoever shall _____ thee to go a mile, go with him twain.
verse: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.
note: Going the second mile starts here: compelled to go one mile? Go with him 'twain' — that's two.
